tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Search DevDocs10 guides (Swift, Python, JavaScript, CSS, HTML) by keywords. Returns the best-matching articles with their paths; read one with get_doc.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Get a DevDocs10 article as Markdown, including tested example output and browser support where available.

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List DevDocs10 articles grouped by topic. Without a section, lists the sections and their topic groups.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_docs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
